# 3. Functions

```{python}
def determine_type(table_text: str, numseps: int = 3, minspace: int = 3, min_frac: float = 0.5) -> str:
    table = table_text.split("\n")

    if len(table) == 0 or all(len(x.strip()) == 0 for x in table):
        return "none"

    if any(re.search(r"<[^/]*informationTable|</[^>]*informationTable", ln, re.I) for ln in table):
        return "xml"

    n = len(table)

    tabseps = sum((ln.count("\t") >= numseps) for ln in table) / n
    comseps = sum((ln.count(",") >= numseps) for ln in table) / n

    spaceseps = 0
    for ln in table:
        matches = re.finditer(r"[A-Za-z0-9]\s+", ln)
        max_len = max([len(m.group(0)) - 1 for m in matches], default=0)
        if max_len >= minspace:
            spaceseps += 1
    spaceseps = spaceseps / n

    scores = {"tab": tabseps, "csv": comseps, "fwf": spaceseps}
    best = max(scores, key=scores.get)

    if scores[best] < min_frac:
        return "csv"

    return best


def regmatches_multiple(pattern: list[str], x: list[str], n: int, min_digits: int = 6, max_digits: int = 9):
    groups = [pattern[i : i + n] for i in range(0, len(pattern), n)]

    starts = [None] * len(x)
    ends = [None] * len(x)

    for grp in groups:
        rx = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(p) for p in grp), re.I)
        for i, ln in enumerate(x):
            m = rx.search(ln)
            if m is not None:
                s, e = m.start(), m.end()
                if starts[i] is None or s < starts[i]:
                    starts[i], ends[i] = s, e

    out_match = []
    out_start = []
    out_end = []

    cusip_regex = re.compile(rf"^([A-Za-z0-9][ -]*){{{min_digits - 1},{max_digits - 1}}}[A-Za-z0-9]")

    for ln, s, e in zip(x, starts, ends):
        if s is None:
            out_match.append(None)
            out_start.append(None)
            out_end.append(None)
            continue

        tail = ln[s:]
        m2 = cusip_regex.search(tail)

        if m2 is None:
            out_match.append(None)
            out_start.append(s)
            out_end.append(None)
            continue

        span = m2.group(0)
        cleaned = re.sub(r"[\s-]", "", span)
        if len(cleaned) < min_digits or len(cleaned) > max_digits:
            cleaned = None

        out_match.append(cleaned)
        out_start.append(s)
        out_end.append(s + len(span))

    return {
        "match": out_match,
        "start": out_start,
        "end": out_end,
    }


def cusip_remainder(table: list[str], cusip_list: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    cusip_key = sorted(set([c[:6].upper() for c in cusip_list if isinstance(c, str) and len(c) >= 6]))
    out = regmatches_multiple(cusip_key, table, max(1, 100), max_digits=9)

    cusip9 = [x.upper() if isinstance(x, str) else None for x in out["match"]]
    ends = out["end"]

    shrs = []
    put_call = []
    inv_disc = []
    remainders = []

    cut_words = [
        "SH", "PRN", "PRIN", "CALL", "PUT", "SOLE", "OTHER", "OTR", "OTH", "DEFINED", "DFND", "DEF", "SHARED", "YES",
    ]
    cut_rx = re.compile(rf"(^|[^A-Za-z])({'|'.join(cut_words)})([^A-Za-z]|$)", re.I)

    for ln, end in zip(table, ends):
        if end is None:
            tail = ""
            rem = ""
        else:
            tail = ln[end:]
            m = cut_rx.search(tail)
            if m is None:
                rem = ln[end:]
            else:
                rem = ln[end : end + m.start()]

        if re.search(r"SH", tail, re.I):
            sh = "SH"
        elif re.search(r"PRN|PRIN", tail, re.I):
            sh = "PRN"
        else:
            sh = None

        if re.search(r"PUT", tail, re.I):
            pc = "PUT"
        elif re.search(r"CALL", tail, re.I):
            pc = "CALL"
        else:
            pc = None

        if re.search(r"SOLE", tail, re.I):
            idisc = "SOLE"
        elif re.search(r"OTHER|OTR|OTH", tail, re.I):
            idisc = "OTR"
        elif re.search(r"DEFINED|DFND|DEF", tail, re.I):
            idisc = "DFND"
        elif re.search(r"SHARED", tail, re.I):
            idisc = "SHARED"
        else:
            idisc = None

        shrs.append(sh)
        put_call.append(pc)
        inv_disc.append(idisc)
        remainders.append(rem)

    return pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "cusip9": cusip9,
            "cusip8": [x[:8] if isinstance(x, str) else None for x in cusip9],
            "shrsOrPrnAmt": shrs,
            "putCall": put_call,
            "investmentDiscretion": inv_disc,
            "remainder": remainders,
        }
    )


def separate_remainder(rows: list[str], regex: str = r"(\d+|\d{1,3}(,\d{3})*)(\.\d*)?") -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        nums = re.findall(regex, row or "")
        vals = []
        for m in nums:
            raw = m[0] if isinstance(m, tuple) else m
            try:
                vals.append(float(raw.replace(",", "")))
            except ValueError:
                continue
        out.append(vals)

    max_len = max((len(x) for x in out), default=0)
    data = {}
    for i in range(max_len):
        data[f"num{i + 1}"] = [vals[i] if i < len(vals) else np.nan for vals in out]

    return pd.DataFrame(data)


def parse_others(table: list[str], cusip_list: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    data = cusip_remainder(table, cusip_list)
    numbers = separate_remainder(data["remainder"].tolist())
    data = pd.concat([data.reset_index(drop=True), numbers.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)

    num_cols = [c for c in data.columns if c.startswith("num")]

    if len(num_cols) == 0:
        value_col = [np.nan] * len(data)
        shares_col = [np.nan] * len(data)
    elif len(num_cols) == 1:
        value_col = [np.nan] * len(data)
        shares_col = data[num_cols[0]].tolist()
    else:
        value_col = data[num_cols[0]].tolist()
        shares_col = data[num_cols[1]].tolist()

    return pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "nameOfIssuer": [None] * len(data),
            "titleOfClass": [None] * len(data),
            "cusip": data["cusip9"],
            "value": value_col,
            "shrsOrPrnAmt": data["shrsOrPrnAmt"],
            "investmentDiscretion": data["investmentDiscretion"],
            "votingAuthority": [None] * len(data),
            "shares": shares_col,
        }
    )


def parse_xml(table: list[str], cusip_list: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    info_start = next((i for i, x in enumerate(table) if re.search(r"^\s*<([A-Za-z0-9_]+:)?informationTable\b", x)), None)
    if info_start is None:
        xml_start = next((i for i, x in enumerate(table) if re.search(r"^\s*<\?xml", x)), 0)
    else:
        xml_start = info_start

    xml_content = "\n".join(table[xml_start:])

    try:
        root = ET.fromstring(xml_content)
    except ET.ParseError:
        return pd.DataFrame(
            columns=[
                "nameOfIssuer",
                "titleOfClass",
                "cusip",
                "value",
                "shrsOrPrnAmt",
                "investmentDiscretion",
                "votingAuthority",
                "shares",
            ]
        )

    rows = []
    for node in root.iter():
        if node.tag.lower().endswith("infotable"):
            row = {}
            for child in node.iter():
                tag = child.tag.split("}")[-1]
                txt = (child.text or "").strip()
                if txt:
                    row[tag] = txt
            if len(row) > 0:
                rows.append(row)

    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

    if len(df) == 0:
        return pd.DataFrame(
            columns=[
                "nameOfIssuer",
                "titleOfClass",
                "cusip",
                "value",
                "shrsOrPrnAmt",
                "investmentDiscretion",
                "votingAuthority",
                "shares",
            ]
        )

    for c in ["cusip", "value", "shrsOrPrnAmt"]:
        if c not in df.columns:
            df[c] = None

    df["cusip"] = df["cusip"].astype(str).str.replace(r"[\s-]", "", regex=True)
    df["value"] = pd.to_numeric(df["value"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\n|\t| ", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")

    shares_temp = df["shrsOrPrnAmt"].astype(str)
    df["shrsOrPrnAmt"] = np.where(
        shares_temp.str.contains("SH", case=False, na=False),
        "SH",
        np.where(shares_temp.str.contains("PRN", case=False, na=False), "PRN", None),
    )
    df["shares"] = pd.to_numeric(
        shares_temp.str.replace(r"\n|\t|SH|PRN| ", "", regex=True),
        errors="coerce",
    )

    for c in ["nameOfIssuer", "titleOfClass", "investmentDiscretion", "votingAuthority"]:
        if c not in df.columns:
            df[c] = None

    return df[
        [
            "nameOfIssuer",
            "titleOfClass",
            "cusip",
            "value",
            "shrsOrPrnAmt",
            "investmentDiscretion",
            "votingAuthority",
            "shares",
        ]
    ]


def gsub_all(pattern: list[str], replacement: list[str], x: str) -> str:
    if len(pattern) == 0:
        return x

    out = x
    for p, r in zip(pattern, replacement):
        if p == "":
            continue
        out = out.replace(p, r)

    return out


def parse_one_table(raw_text: str, cusip_list: list[str]) -> pd.DataFrame:
    table = str(raw_text).split("\n")
    typ = determine_type(str(raw_text))

    if typ == "none":
        return pd.DataFrame(
            columns=[
                "nameOfIssuer",
                "titleOfClass",
                "cusip",
                "value",
                "shrsOrPrnAmt",
                "investmentDiscretion",
                "votingAuthority",
                "shares",
                "table_type",
            ]
        )

    if typ == "tab":
        table = [ln.replace("\t", " ") for ln in table]
    elif typ == "csv":
        fixed = []
        for ln in table:
            quoted = re.findall(r'(".*?")', ln)
            quoted_nocomma = [q.replace('"', "").replace(",", "") for q in quoted]
            fixed_ln = ln
            for q, qc in zip(quoted, quoted_nocomma):
                fixed_ln = fixed_ln.replace(q, qc)
            fixed.append(re.sub(r"\t|,", " ", fixed_ln))
        table = fixed

    if typ == "xml":
        out = parse_xml(table, cusip_list)
    else:
        out = parse_others(table, cusip_list)

    out = out.copy()
    out["table_type"] = typ

    keep_cols = [
        "nameOfIssuer",
        "titleOfClass",
        "cusip",
        "value",
        "shrsOrPrnAmt",
        "investmentDiscretion",
        "votingAuthority",
        "shares",
        "table_type",
    ]

    for c in keep_cols:
        if c not in out.columns:
            out[c] = None

    return out[keep_cols]


def build_quarter_tables(year_qtr: str) -> None:
    con = connect_sqlite(year_qtr)

    try:
        header_table = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM header_table", con)
        holdings_table_raw = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM holdings_table_raw", con)

        if len(holdings_table_raw) == 0:
            return

        yr = int(str(year_qtr)[:4])
        use_cusip_join = yr >= 1996
        cusip_list = get_cusip_vec(con, year_qtr) if use_cusip_join else []

        print(f"Parsing {len(holdings_table_raw)} filings in parallel...")

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(cfg.workers, 5)) as ex:
            parsed_list = list(ex.map(lambda x: parse_one_table(x, cusip_list), holdings_table_raw["holding_text"].astype(str).tolist()))

        out_frames = []
        for fname, p in zip(holdings_table_raw["FILENAME"].tolist(), parsed_list):
            p = p.copy()
            p["filename"] = fname
            out_frames.append(p)

        parsed_q = pd.concat(out_frames, ignore_index=True) if len(out_frames) > 0 else pd.DataFrame()

        hdr = header_table[["FILENAME", "form", "cik", "cikname", "rdate", "fdate"]].rename(columns={"FILENAME": "filename"})

        parsed_q = parsed_q.merge(hdr, on="filename", how="left")

        parsed_q = parsed_q[
            [
                "form",
                "cik",
                "cikname",
                "rdate",
                "fdate",
                "filename",
                "nameOfIssuer",
                "titleOfClass",
                "cusip",
                "value",
                "shrsOrPrnAmt",
                "investmentDiscretion",
                "votingAuthority",
                "shares",
                "table_type",
            ]
        ]

        parsed_q.to_sql("holdings_table_parsed", con, if_exists="replace", index=False)
    finally:
        disconnect_sqlite(con)
```

# 4. Loop over all quarters

```{python}
for i, yq in enumerate(dates["year_qtr"].tolist(), start=1):
    print(f"=== Starting quarter {yq} ({i}/{len(dates)}) ===")
    start_time = time.time()

    build_quarter_tables(yq)

    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"Total time for {yq}: {elapsed / 60:.1f} minutes ({elapsed:.1f} seconds)")
```

# 5. Parse summary

```{python}
rows = []
for i, yq in enumerate(dates["year_qtr"].tolist(), start=1):
    print(f"\n=== Quarter {i}/{len(dates)}: {yq} ===")
    con = connect_sqlite(yq)

    try:
        raw_counts = pd.read_sql_query(
            "SELECT FILENAME, COUNT(*) AS raw_nrows FROM holdings_table_raw GROUP BY FILENAME",
            con,
        )
        parsed_counts = pd.read_sql_query(
            "SELECT filename, COUNT(*) AS parsed_nrows FROM holdings_table_parsed GROUP BY filename",
            con,
        )

        joined = raw_counts.merge(parsed_counts, how="left", left_on="FILENAME", right_on="filename")
        joined["parsed_nrows"] = joined["parsed_nrows"].fillna(0)

        rows.append(
            {
                "year_qtr": yq,
                "n_raw_nonzero": int((joined["raw_nrows"] > 0).sum()),
                "n_parsed_some": int((joined["parsed_nrows"] > 0).sum()),
            }
        )
    finally:
        disconnect_sqlite(con)

parse_summary = pd.DataFrame(rows)
parse_summary["year_qtr_num"] = parse_summary["year_qtr"].astype(int)
parse_summary["pct_parsed_raw"] = parse_summary["n_parsed_some"] / parse_summary["n_raw_nonzero"].clip(lower=1)
parse_summary["year"] = parse_summary["year_qtr_num"] // 10
parse_summary["qtr"] = parse_summary["year_qtr_num"] % 10

qtr_map = {1: "02-15", 2: "05-15", 3: "08-15", 4: "11-15"}
parse_summary["quarter_date"] = pd.to_datetime(
    parse_summary["year"].astype(str) + "-" + parse_summary["qtr"].map(qtr_map)
)
parse_summary = parse_summary.sort_values("quarter_date")

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
plt.axhline(0.95, linestyle="--", color="grey")
plt.plot(parse_summary["quarter_date"], parse_summary["pct_parsed_raw"], color="steelblue")
plt.scatter(parse_summary["quarter_date"], parse_summary["pct_parsed_raw"], s=12, color="steelblue")
plt.ylim(0, 1)
plt.title("Parsing success rate over time")
plt.tight_layout()

parse_summary.to_csv(qa_dir_03 / "parse_summary.csv", index=False)
plt.savefig(qa_dir_03 / "parse_summary.png", dpi=300)
plt.close()
```
